privacy.title: Privacy policy (draft)
privacy.draftNotice: This text is an informational draft. It must be reviewed by a lawyer before the app is offered to the public.

sections.p: Nicknames, avatars, grade, progress, coins and badges. No real names, emails or location are requested.
By default, only on this device. If the family enables sync, an encrypted copy (encrypted on the device) is sent to a server; the server cannot read it.
The app uses no ads, analytics or tracking cookies.
Parents can export, import and delete all data from the PIN-protected panel, including the cloud copy.
The app is intended for children under the supervision of a parent or guardian, who gives consent during setup.
The app is an educational practice tool. It does not replace school teaching.
Provided as is. If you lose the family code or the PIN, the data cannot be recovered.
These terms may change. This is a draft pending legal review.
